sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: A Healthy Alternative is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. I understand that you were tasked with finding the laboratory log from the polychemical plant. Apparently, TerraGroup is willing to pay handsomely for the extraction of their documents. I urge you to reconsider. If the corporation cares so much about this material, it must be hiding something valuable! Obviously, I mean valuable to the city and its citizens. Just leave the journal in my care."

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- 1× Lucky Scav Junk box
"You picked the right side! This journal will be very useful to my acquaintance in his experiments.... I mean, research! This way we can alleviate the suffering of the Tarkov citizens who are still in the city."

sections.heading: Failure Dialogue
sections.text: "You've decided to return the journal to the corp? You don't seem to care much for the people of this town. I'm disappointed in your choice."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
By completing One Less Loose End, you will lose access to this quest.
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Lab journal | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
The journal can be found in the laboratory on the second floor of Factory. There are multiple spawns throughout both rooms.
